description: How the brand's PostKing-made Reddit posts and replies are doing. Free, read-only. Data comes from the PostKing extension, which reads the user's own Reddit profile every few hours and keeps only items made from PostKing drafts (Reddit post drafts + reply drafts). days: 7 | 30 | 90 (default 7). Returns { sync, kpis (views, posted, upvotes, removed — each with previous period — and toPost), toPost (drafts and reply drafts still waiting, oldest first), ambiguous (posts needing the user to confirm which draft they came from), posted (each live item: subreddit, permalink, postedAt, views, upvotes, comments, status live|removed|hidden|deleted), communities (per subreddit: views, typical upvotes, removed %), byType (posts vs replies), insights }. Views exist for posts only (Reddit doesn't count views on comments). Use removals per community before suggesting where to post next. sync.lastSyncAt null means the extension hasn't synced yet.
name: reddit_performance
